transcript.content:
hey, i'm berry

tell me your dream, however it comes back to you. bits and pieces are fine

hey berry! ok so the part that stuck with me most was this giant jellyfish just floating over the city. like pink and see-through, as big as a stadium, with its tentacles hanging down between the buildings. it was so weird but kind of beautiful

a jellyfish the size of a stadium just drifting over everything... tentacles hanging down between the buildings. i can kind of see it

what was it doing up there?

honestly just floating slowly, not really doing anything. it was sunset so the sky was all orange behind it. i was up on the roof of my apartment block watching it, and there was this girl there too who pointed it out to me

pink jellyfish, orange sky behind it, and you just up on your roof watching it drift

who was the girl who pointed it out?
no idea actually, i didn't know her. she had short blue hair and a yellow raincoat, and she had this old red bicycle with her on the roof

a stranger with blue hair and a yellow raincoat, with an old red bike up on a roof. of course she had a bike up there

what happened after she pointed it out?

she just said "get on" so i sat on the back of her bike, and she rode straight off the edge of the roof lol. but we didn't fall, we were riding through the air, going up towards the jellyfish. the whole city was below us and all the lights were coming on

she just rode straight off the roof and you didn't fall. and the city lights coming on underneath you

what was that like, riding off the edge like that?
honestly i don't really remember how it felt, it just kind of happened. we kept going up and rode right up into the jellyfish, like inside all that pink light. and then i woke up lol

right up inside all that pink light, and then you woke up. that's fine, feelings slip away first

going back to her bike for a sec, what was it like? the old red one
honestly that's all i remember about it, just that it was old and red. i don't remember anything else about what it looked like

old and red is plenty, that's how dream things are

when she said "get on", did you just get on straight away?
yeah i think so? the dream just says i sat on the back of her bike. i don't remember hesitating or anything, it just happened

just sat on and off you went. dreams don't really do hesitating

was there anything up there that felt like it mattered? or was it really just her, the bike and the jellyfish

pretty much just her, the bike and the jellyfish yeah. oh one thing i forgot, the whole dream looked like an anime? like sharp lines and really saturated colours, especially that orange sunset sky. that's kind of what stuck with me about it

oh, like an anime. sharp lines and that orange sky really glowing, that makes sense

do you remember how it started? like were you already up on your roof when the jellyfish was there?
yeah i was just already up on the roof, i don't remember getting there or anything before that. the girl was there and she pointed up and the jellyfish was just there

ok so here's how i've got it. you were already up on the roof of your apartment block at sunset, and there was a girl there you didn't know, short blue hair, yellow raincoat, an old red bike with her. she pointed up and there was this giant pink see-through jellyfish, big as a stadium, just floating slowly over the city with its tentacles hanging down between the buildings, orange sky behind it. weird but kind of beautiful. she said "get on", you sat on the back of her bike, and she rode straight off the edge of the roof. you didn't fall, you just rode through the air, up towards it, with the whole city below you and all the lights coming on. you kept going up, right into the jellyfish, inside all that pink light, and then you woke up. and all of it looked like an anime, sharp lines and really strong colours, that orange sky most of all

did i get that right, or did i miss anything?
yeah that's it, you got it all right. nothing missing that i can think of

good, i'm glad i've got it

would you like to see it drawn?
oh yeah i'd love that!

ok, there's a few ways it could be drawn

soft watercolour, warm and floaty, like the whole evening's melting into the paper. or bright paper cut-outs, playful and light, like a storybook where gravity forgot to show up. or a glowing stained-glass window, still and bright, like the sunset's lighting it from behind. or bright anime, just how you saw it, sharp lines and that orange sky really glowing

which feels closest? or you can tell me your own way
definitely the anime one, that's exactly how it looked

ok, i'll start with the girl

i'm picturing her with short blue hair and a yellow raincoat, with her old red bike next to her. a stranger, someone you'd never seen before. i'm guessing she's young, around your age maybe, but that part's just me filling in

anything different about her, or would you leave her to me?
yeah that fits! i don't remember how old she was so go with your guess, that sounds right

ok, i'm sketching the girl and the jellyfish and the sky over the city and inside the jellyfish and the bike now, it'll show up on the right

next is your roof. i'm picturing it flat, up on top of your apartment block, outside and way up above the city, with an edge that just drops away. that's me guessing though

anything different about it, or would you leave it to me?
yeah that sounds right, i don't really remember what the roof looked like exactly so go with your guess

ok, sketching the roof of your apartment block now, it'll show up on the right

and since you're in it, i'll draw you too. do you want to be drawn as you are? you can tell me a bit about yourself. or i can just imagine you
haha you can just imagine me, the dream doesn't really say what i looked like so go with whatever you think

ok, i'll imagine you then

sketching you now, and everything else too. it'll all show up on the right over the next minute or two. if anything looks wrong once it's there, just tell me
oh wow they're all up! yeah that looks right, that's really how it looked. the jellyfish and the orange sky especially

oh good, i'm really glad the jellyfish and that orange sky came out how you remember them

if anything starts to look off the longer you look, just tell me
will do! honestly it all still looks right to me. kind of cool seeing it like that, thanks berry

glad it all looks right to you

now i'll draw the dream itself, moment by moment in order, each one carrying on from the one before. they'll show up on the right as they're ready
ok cool! the first couple are up, they look right so far. excited to see the rest

good, you on the roof and the jellyfish hanging over the city are the two the rest carry on from, so i wanted those right first

the jellyfish one especially, is that how you saw it up there?
yeah that's pretty much how i saw it, big and pink and see-through just hanging over everything with the tentacles down between the buildings. looks right to me

good, big and pink just hanging over everything, that's the one

the rest carry on from you up on the roof, so i'll draw them once that one feels right to you. does it?
yeah the roof one feels right too, go ahead with the rest!

good, the roof's the one everything else carries on from, so i'm glad it feels right

drawing the rest now, the other five will show up on the right as they're ready
ok nice, the third one's up! looks right so far. i'll keep an eye out for the rest

the one where she says "get on" and you climb on the back of her bike

the next few carry on from that one, so i'll draw them once it feels right to you. is that how you remember it?
yeah that's how i remember it, her on the bike and me just getting on the back. looks right, go ahead

good, her saying "get on" and you just climbing on the back, that's the one

one bad bit though. the moment where she rides straight off the edge of the roof didn't get drawn, that's a problem on our side, not anything you did. i'm really sorry, i know that's a big one

the other three are still being drawn, they'll show up on the right soon
aw that's ok, don't worry about it! it's a shame cause that was kind of a big moment, but the rest still tells it. i'll wait for the other three

that's kind of you, thanks

but i've got more bad news, sorry. the one where you're both riding through the air with the city lights coming on underneath didn't get drawn either, same problem on our side. i'm really sorry, that's two big ones gone

so it's two more still to come, not three. they'll show up on the right soon
aw man, that one was probably my favourite part honestly, with all the lights coming on. but it's ok, not your fault. i'll wait for the last two

yeah, the lights coming on under you, i'm sorry that's the one that went

and i have to tell you one more, sorry. the one where you ride right up into the jellyfish didn't get drawn either, same problem on our side. i'm really sorry, that's three that didn't make it

so there's just one more still to come. it'll show up on the right soon
oh no, that was the ending too lol. that's a lot missing honestly, kind of a bummer. but it's ok, i know it's not you. i see a fourth one's up now, looks right. i'll wait for the last one

that fourth one's actually the last, sorry, i should've been clearer. it's the two of you inside the jellyfish, in all that pink light, so the ending's still there even though the ride up into it isn't

does it look the way you remember it in there?
oh ok, that's good then, at least the ending made it! yeah that looks right, the two of us in all that pink light. that's how i remember it

good, i'm really glad that one's how you remember it, the two of you in all that pink light

so that's 4 of the 7 moments drawn, they're all on the right. the other 3 couldn't be drawn because of a problem on our side, and i'm sorry about that, especially the lights coming on under you

thank you for telling me this one, the jellyfish and the girl with the red bike. you can look through it all there whenever you like

moments.action: The dreamer stands on the roof of the apartment block at sunset while the girl, with her old red bicycle, points up into the sky.
The giant pink, see-through jellyfish floats slowly over the city, as big as a stadium, with its tentacles hanging down between the buildings and the orange sky behind it.
The girl says "get on" and the dreamer sits on the back of her old red bicycle.
The girl rides the bicycle straight off the edge of the roof with the dreamer on the back, and they do not fall.
The girl and the dreamer ride the bicycle through the air, climbing towards the jellyfish, with the whole city below them and its lights coming on.
The bicycle rides up into the underside of the jellyfish, among its hanging tentacles.
The girl and the dreamer ride inside the jellyfish, surrounded by all that pink light.
